note: On the shore of 1,670-acre Moose Lake, a flowage drawn down each winter, with a sandy beach and boat ramp. Tent-only sites are 1, 5 and 15. Off-road vehicle trails are nearby, but ATVs and UTVs may not be driven in the campground and must stay on a trailer there. --Claude
